newsitem.title: UK: BT gives no comment on Tele Danmark talk.
newsitem.headline: BT gives no comment on Tele Danmark talk.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc on Wednesday would not comment on market talk that it was considering tightening links with Tele Danmark A/S by buying a stake in the operator.
"We talk to lots of people all the time about lots of things," a company spokeswoman said. "We never comment on rumour and market speculation."
BT formed an alliance, called Telenordia, with the Danish and Norwegian telcoms operators in May 1995. Telenordia operates in Sweden and the three partners each have an equal stake in the venture.
However, the deal was not reinforced with share swaps.

Since then, BT has launched a $20 billion takeover of its American partner MCI Communications Corp and has swapped small stakes with its new Iberian partners -- Telefonica De Espana and Portugal Telecom SA.
The BT spokeswoman described the Telefonica and Portugal Telecom stake swaps as gestures of goodwill.
